predictions.articleTitle: Yemen vs Malaysia Prediction & Match Analysis: Can Depleted Tigers Resist? — Scoreline Preview

Under 2.5 Goals: A 2.25 combined Poisson lambda and Malaysia's missing forward firepower concentrate 60.9% probability within zero to two total goals (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
